root: Uni-CLI 0.224.1 is a patch release for the live adapter catalog after 0.224.0.
`marxists-cn` now exposes a Chinese archive reader with normalized text output and Chinese search/discovery aliases.
Twitter timeline/comment commands now expose user timeline and comment retrieval paths through the adapter catalog.
Release records, public docs, skills, MCP registry metadata, and generated stats now point at 0.224.1.
zh: Uni-CLI 0.224.1 是 0.224.0 之后面向 live adapter catalog 的 patch release。
`marxists-cn` 现在提供中文档案阅读器，带规范化文本输出和中文搜索/发现别名。
Twitter timeline/comment 命令现在通过 adapter catalog 暴露用户时间线和评论读取路径。
Release records、public docs、skills、MCP registry metadata 和 generated stats 现在都指向 0.224.1。
